prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Conroe, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1328; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, if that's okay. I can confirm I was the driver involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?

A: It was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Conroe, Texas. I was pulling out of a parking space near the main entrance.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?

A: I had checked my mirror and started backing out slowly. I was maybe going two or three miles an hour. Then I felt a bump on the passenger side.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the contact?

A: No, not until after. It was a pickup truck coming down the aisle. I think the driver was looking for a spot and didn't see me.

Q: Did you or the other driver stop or exchange information?

A: We both got out and talked. We exchanged insurance information and took some photos of the bumpers.

Q: Were you injured in the collision?

A: Yes. I put my right hand out to brace myself against the steering wheel and my wrist hit hard. The doctor later said it was fractured. I've been wearing a splint and I can't drive for a few weeks.

Q: Have you received medical treatment for the wrist?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same afternoon and then I saw an orthopedic specialist. I'm still going to physical therapy.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was being careful and I think the other driver should have been watching more closely. That's all I have.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
